# What Fashion Owes Its Craftspeople — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-81630
Voiceover: Materials such as silk, glass, and metallic thread make skilled transformation visible while the museum record still names only the house as maker.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Agnes de Mille, 1977

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CA08-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · NAME — Can the worker choose to be credited?. Build role-level credits with consent: cutter, embroiderer, weaver, dyer, machinist, finisher, presser, sample maker, repairer, and others as locally accurate. Protect people where naming creates risk.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA08-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · PAY — What commercial decisions reach the workroom?. Trace price, lead time, revisions, cancellations, overtime, payment schedule, subcontracting, and remedy. Purchasing decisions upstream can shape downstream labor outcomes; verify the actual chain.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA08-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · VOICE — Who can refuse, correct, and report harm?. Document worker-representation and grievance routes, anti-retaliation protections, safety escalation, correction of public credits, and who controls the response. A feedback form without remedy is not voice.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA08-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · KNOWLEDGE — What does preservation return?. With consent, preserve process narration, terminology, samples, and contributor authority. Do not convert community knowledge into proprietary house content without permission, attribution, benefit, and cultural review.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

Voiceover: Joyce A. Bailey Oral History Interview is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
